description: Gnat IE1245 mounted on pedestals at the Bagdogra AFS main gate, four underwing pylons (probably Ajeet-standard upgrade), no ejection seat; identity revealed by 2016 photos. Bharat-rakshak: gate guardian Bagdogra. Source warbirds.in.

Su-7 B844 displayed in the northern part of Bagdogra airfield alongside a captured Pakistani M24 Chaffee tank from 1971; a second Su-7 on the airfield was removed in 2013. Mosmap 26.687787 88.331882. Source warbirds.in (2009, updated 2016 photos).

Type 66-400 MiG-21U U455 on concrete pylons at the Bagdogra Officers Mess (reported Jan 2017). Note a second airframe painted U-455 exists at Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu; both show Type 66 fin so one painted identity is wrong. A stripped sister U458 (No.8 Sqn badge) was stored elsewhere on the base. Source warbirds.in; bharat-rakshak carries both locations for U-455.
